Signature.name: Signature
Signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw request body, signed with the merchant secret key and hex-encoded. The same `Signature` header is also sent by Smartpayz on outgoing webhook requests so the merchant can verify them. See [Signature Calculation](https://docs.smartpayz.com/docs/request-signature) for the full algorithm.
